destinations.name: Araw ng Pagbilao / Papag at Bilao Festival
destinations.description: Annual August celebration honoring St. Catherine of Alexandria and the founding of Pagbilao, with street dancing, cultural programs, floats, parades, and pageant activities.

howToGetThere.fromLucenaGrandTerminal: Ride a jeepney or bus bound for Pagbilao, Atimonan, or Bicol route and ask to be dropped near Pagbilao town proper or Municipal Hall. Verify with driver before boarding.
notes: Festival traffic and road closures may change routes and drop-off points.

fees.notes: Public festival activities may be free, but specific events or venues may have separate rules.

visitorTips: Arrive early during parade days.
Check official advisories for road closures and schedules.
Bring water, sun protection, and cash.

destinations.description: Historic viewpoint in Quezon where visitors can see towns including Atimonan, Pagbilao, Tayabas, Lucena, and Padre Burgos from the summit.

notes: This is a nearby Quezon destination, not necessarily inside Pagbilao. Confirm access point and route before presenting as a Pagbilao itinerary stop.
